summary: Comprehensive testing of ROSCA Member Access & Collaboration features completed. All 26 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all member access components working correctly including group access link, member passcodes, passcode update, member login, member portal with chat and online indicators.

POST /api/groups/{id}/members - sends invitation email when email provided
GET /api/groups/{id}/members-access - returns members with passcodes and access links
PUT /api/groups/{id}/members/{id}/passcode - auto-generates new passcode
PUT /api/groups/{id}/members/{id}/passcode - accepts manual passcode
POST /api/groups/{id}/members/{id}/resend-invite - fails for member without email
POST /api/groups/{id}/members/{id}/resend-invite - sends email for member with email
GET /api/groups/{id}/access-link - returns group shareable link
GET /api/group-access/{code}/info - returns group info by access code (public)
GET /api/group-access/{code}/info - returns 404 for invalid code
POST /api/group-access/{code}/login - member login with valid passcode
POST /api/group-access/{code}/login - returns 401 for invalid passcode
POST /api/group-access/{code}/login - returns 404 for invalid access code
GET /api/member-portal/group - returns group data for member
POST /api/member-portal/heartbeat - updates online status
GET /api/member-portal/chat - returns chat messages
POST /api/member-portal/chat - sends chat message
POST /api/member-portal/chat - rejects empty message
POST /api/member-portal/chat - truncates message to 500 chars
Member portal requires valid token (401 for invalid)
GET /api/groups/{id}/chat - moderator view of chat
POST /api/groups/{id}/chat - moderator sends chat message with (Moderator) suffix
POST /api/groups/{id}/chat - rejects empty message
Full member access flow (get info -> login -> portal -> heartbeat -> chat)
GroupDetail page Member Access tab shows passcodes and link
GroupAccess page allows member login with passcode
MemberPortal page shows group info, members online, and chat
critical_code_review_comments: Passcode format (adjective-noun-number) is user-friendly and easy to remember
Member access tokens expire in 24 hours - appropriate for security
Online status determined by heartbeat < 30 seconds - good real-time indicator
Chat messages limited to 500 characters - prevents abuse
Email notifications sent via AgentMail when member added or passcode updated

context_for_next_testing_agent: Member Access & Collaboration features fully tested and working. Key endpoints: /api/group-access/{code}/info (public), /api/group-access/{code}/login (public), /api/member-portal/* (member token required). Member tokens are different from main auth tokens. Heartbeat updates online status every 5 seconds. Chat messages stored in chat_messages collection. Passcodes are auto-generated in format adjective-noun-number (e.g., keen-moon-13). Email notifications sent via AgentMail for invitations and passcode updates.
